question: Estimate the daily Google searches originating from India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All search query types: web, images, mobile, voice? Yes — all.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: Indian internet users × searches per user per day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, Google search users (search query in past day): ~50% (others may use only WhatsApp/social) = ~375M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily searches from India: 375M × 8 = ~3 billion searches.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: 2.5-3.5 billion daily Indian Google searches.
